role_note: MIDI-RWKV is a symbolic infilling model. If it were ever routable it would be a candidate generator feeding the critic, never the arranger and never a default. It is not routable: see routing_status.

model.distribution_note: The base weights ship inside the source repository rather than on a model hub, so there is no separate weight licence: they inherit the terms of what they were trained on.

runtime.note: No runtime is pinned because none is authorised to build. Pins belong to a build that is permitted to exist.

routing_status_note: Base weights are a derivative of CC-BY-NC-4.0 training data. A permissive code licence does not remove the NC term. Commercial routing fails closed, exactly as it does for LADA_BAND and DIFFRHYTHM_2.
